title: From GPU to TPU with Coding Agents: What Works, What Fails, and What It Costs?
abstract: arXiv:2610.34422v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A coding agent can migrate a machine learning workload, report success, and still change how the model trains. Rising compute costs, limited accelerator capacity, and vendor dependence are pushing organizations toward alternatives to graphics processing units (GPUs); a key question is whether agent-generated migrations to tensor processing units (TPUs) can be trusted and at what cost. We build a dataset of 148 PyTorch ML research projects and use Claude Code to migrate ten of them from NVIDIA GPUs to Google Cloud TPUs. We independently assess whether each migration runs, preserves numerical behavior, executes on the intended hardware, maintains the project's goal, and delivers acceptable performance. We also examine failures, human effort, and costs. Eight projects meet our project-goal criterion, and migrations require 2.4 human interventions on average. translated_title: 使用编程智能体从GPU迁移到TPU：什么有效、什么失败、代价几何？
translated_abstract: 一个编程智能体可以迁移一个机器学习工作负载并报告成功，但仍然会改变模型的训练方式。不断上涨的计算成本、有限的加速器容量以及对供应商的依赖，正促使各组织寻求图形处理器（GPU）的替代方案；一个关键问题是，由智能体生成的向张量处理单元（TPU）的迁移是否可信、其代价如何。我们构建了一个包含148个PyTorch机器学习研究项目的数据集，并使用Claude Code将其中十个项目从NVIDIA GPU迁移到Google Cloud TPU。我们独立评估每次迁移是否能够运行、是否保持数值行为、是否在预期硬件上执行、是否维持项目目标，以及是否提供可接受的性能。我们还考察了失败情况、人工投入与成本。八个项目满足我们的项目目标标准，迁移平均需要2.4次人工干预。在70次执行尝试中，53次失败（76%），其中26次失败（49%）没有引发任何错误信息。
tldr: 该研究构建了148个PyTorch研究项目的数据集，并使用Claude Code将其中10个项目从NVIDIA GPU迁移到Google Cloud TPU，通过独立评估发现迁移平均需2.4次人工干预、76%的执行尝试失败且近半数失败不报错，首次系统量化了智能体驱动代码迁移的可信度与成本。
en_tdlr: This study builds a dataset of 148 PyTorch research projects, uses Claude Code to migrate ten of them from NVIDIA GPUs to Google Cloud TPUs, and systematically quantifies for the first time the trustworthiness and cost of agent-driven code migration, finding that migrations average 2.4 human interventions while 76% of execution attempts fail—nearly half of them silently.
